intro: Browman Mill is a blighted lumber mill situated just north of Light's Hope Chapel in the Eastern Plaguelands. Once a thriving piece of Lordaeron's timber trade, it now swarms with undead minions under the iron grip of the Scourge. Its former proprietor, Stephen Browman, remains trapped in death within his ruined workshop.

p: Before the Third War, Browman Mill served the surrounding towns and homesteads of Lordaeron, processing lumber harvested from the rich forests of the Eastweald. When the Scourge plague rolled across the kingdom, the mill fell alongside the rest of the province. Today, rotting timbers and shattered wheels sit idle while abominations, banshees, and skeletal warriors patrol the perimeter. Its close proximity to Light's Hope Chapel makes it a constant and menacing reminder of the undead horde pressing against the Argent Dawn's doorstep.

The mill's original owner, Stephen Browman, met the same grim fate as countless commoners of Lordaeron. Murdered when the Scourge overran the estate, he was raised into undeath as a ravenous ghoul. Stripped of his humanity and enslaved to the Lich King's will, Browman lingers within the dark confines of his former mill, guarding the splintered ruins of his life's work.
